name: Native git dependencies are pinned by revision
instruction: Native desktop and agent git dependencies are pinned to immutable revisions rather than floating branches or unqualified repository URLs.
relevant_when: package.json, Cargo.toml, or lockfile content under Hoppscotch desktop, agent, common, selfhost-web, or desktop plugin workspace that declares a dependency sourced from git, GitHub, or a repository URL.
context: Recent dependency review for native Tauri plugins emphasized pinning git-based plugin dependencies by explicit revisions so desktop, agent, and self-hosted builds remain reproducible.
scope_reason: Each manifest or lockfile contains the dependency source string needed to determine whether the git dependency is pinned.

checklist.name: git-source-has-immutable-revision
checklist.rule: Every git or GitHub dependency source in the file includes an immutable commit revision, rev parameter, or exact commit hash rather than only a branch name, tag-like channel, or bare repository URL.

checklist.name: lockfile-preserves-pin
checklist.rule: When the file is a lockfile, git dependency entries preserve the same pinned revision information instead of resolving to an unpinned source.
